instructions.primary_message: Line the bottom and sides of a large baking dish with parchment paper and set aside.
Place butter in a large pot and melt over medium-low heat.
Add mini marshmallows to the pot and heat, stirring constantly, until melted and combined with the butter, about 5 minutes. Add food coloring, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (283 g) pkg mini marshmallows
3 drops red food coloring

instructions.primary_message: Add cereal to the pot and stir until thoroughly combined.
Pour cereal mixture into the prepared baking dish and, using the back of a metal spoon, spread into the sides, forming an even layer. Set aside to cool, about 1 hour (it will firm up as it cools).

Transfer cooled marshmallow mixture to a cutting board. Use a heart-shaped cookie cutter to make individual treats. (With the cutter facing right-side up, cut a row of hearts across the top side. Flip the cutter right-side down, and cut a second row of hearts, using as much of the marshmallow mixture as possible.)
Arrange marshmallow hearts on a plate and enjoy!
